method: All eleven corrected production screenshots were opened and actually viewed at original detail across two image-viewer calls.
observations: The initial scene remains coherent in all eleven representative layouts: city, railway, rooftop actors and foreground details preserve their alignment and pixel grid.
At time zero the street car keeps the prior 25 percent route progress by calculation; the full-scene images are accepted as composition evidence rather than proof of the faster timing.
limitations: Initial still images do not demonstrate speed, the six-second absence, the next pass, or every occlusion instant; those require the production activity capture.
The street car is deliberately tiny and partly occluded in the full scenes, so these images do not establish continuous lamp legibility.
